%s walked the new ship end to end twice and went back to its carrier.

%s climbs onto your boot and stays there until you move.
%s comes up to the glass where your hand is and stays there until you take it away.
%s drifts down until it touches your palm, then lifts away again.
%s lands on your shoulder and stays there through the next comm call.
%s leans its whole weight against your hand.
%s stops its rounds and lets you run a thumb over the warm housing.
%s does not move. The quartermaster says that is how it shows approval.
%s pushes its head under your fingers and mutters a word it learned from the deck crew.
%s wraps one tentacle around your wrist. The medic gets the antitoxin out of the cabinet.
%s changes colour along the line of your hand and holds the pattern for a few seconds.
%s buzzes once and settles against your arm.
%s winds once around your forearm. The cabin lights dim for a second.
%s drifts to the side of the jar nearest your hand and turns a shade warmer.
%s accepts a pat on the shoulder and tells you which of your officers it would have hired.
%s puts up with it, which the crew says is a good sign.
